name: BinHV27 (trend-regime ADX/DI/RSI dip)
author: berlinguyinca collection (author not stated in file)
indicators: RSI(5)+EMA5 of RSI, ADX, +DI/-DI and EMAs (25), SMAs (high/low/slow), regime flags (preparechangetrend, continueup, bigup, bigdown)
entry_long: slowsma>0 AND close<highsma AND close<lowsma AND minusdi>minusdiema AND rsi>=rsi[-1] AND one of 4 regime branches with ADX>25/30/35 and emarsi<=20 (see source)
